createHint: Choose any table and a title field. The blog layout publishes only selected rows and images.
name: View name
fieldsHint: Only mapped fields and explicitly selected images enter the public copy. Authors show names only; related records and other fields stay private.
pending: Unpublished changes. Publish explicitly to update the public copy.
upToDate: The current published copy is online.
discardDraftDescription: Discard unsaved view settings and load the latest saved configuration. You can copy the draft first.
draftCopyFailed: Could not copy the draft. Keep it open and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Please copy the link manually.
selectionHint: Choose up to 20 rows. Save keeps content private; select each image explicitly.
noDocument: Open the article to start writing.
assetsHint: Select each image explicitly. Unselected body images are omitted; covers must belong to the mapped file field.
noSources: This table has no rows yet.
recallHint: Withdraw this row or site from public access. Other rows keep their published copies. Withdraw rows before deleting their source data.
limits: Up to 20 articles, 60 images, 30 MiB of images per site; 5 MiB per PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF image. Generated HTML up to 4 MiB, 10 articles per page. Up to 100 regular internal versions including configurations; recall versions are exempt. RSS and sitemap are not provided.
publishHint: Publish the selected rows, mapped fields and selected images. Visitors need no account. Later source edits stay private.

errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Request failed. Reload and try again.
errors.BAD_INPUT: Check field mappings, titles, unique URL slugs and selected images.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The blog, source article or file is missing or inaccessible. Reload to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this blog operation.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The draft or published version changed. Reload before continuing.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: Source content changed or is still public. Rebuild; recall articles before deleting sources.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This retry identifier belongs to another request. Reload and try again.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The blog exceeds its count or size limit. Reduce articles or images, or create another site.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Image or publication storage is unavailable. The public copy is unchanged; retry this build.
errors.UNPUBLISH_REQUIRED: Unpublish the site in the blog editor before deleting it.

bindExisting: Advanced: bind an existing content table
